title: Pilaf with Russian Cured Meat and Caramelized Plums
description: A hearty and flavorful pilaf dish featuring Russian cured meat and sweet caramelized plums.

ingredients.name: Russian cured meat (such as salo or kielbasa)

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the diced onions and cook until caramelized, about 5 minutes.
Add the diced plums and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the diced Russian cured meat and cook until browned, about 3 minutes.
Add the pilaf rice to the skillet and stir to combine with the meat and vegetables.
Add the chicken broth to the skillet and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 18-20 minutes, or until the rice is cooked and the liquid has been absorbed.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and season with salt to taste.
